findings.title: Allowlist cache is never invalidated, so changes lag by 60s
findings.body: The result is cached for 60s, and invalidate_upsampling_cache is never called when the option changes. Removing a project from the allowlist keeps upsampling on for up to a minute. The options lookup is already cheap, so drop this cache.

findings.title: Unrelated submodule pointer committed
findings.body: A `sentry-repo` subproject commit entry has nothing to do with this feature. Remove it from the PR.

findings.title: Discover eligibility check is a loose substring match
findings.body: For the discover dataset, eligibility only checks for the literal substring `event.type:error` in the query. A query like `!event.type:error`, or one that ORs in transactions, is treated as errors-only. Upsampling is then applied to rows that are not errors. Parse the query properly instead.

findings.title: Cache key uses hash() of project ids, which can collide
findings.body: The key uses hash(tuple(...)). Two different project sets can collide and share a cached eligibility result. That could apply upsampling to non-allowlisted projects, or skip it for allowlisted ones. Build the key from the sorted ids joined as a string, or hash it with sha1. Apply the same change in invalidate_upsampling_cache.

findings.title: upsampled_count sums sample_weight without a null fallback
findings.body: It sums sample_weight with no fallback. Events stored without that value count as 0 or NULL. The function is also public, so users can call it in any discover query. Use a coalesce-to-1 fallback and mark the function private.
